pages.title: Loves Me Not
pages.text: Oxeye Daisy · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Oxeye Daisy Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)Pluck one - loves me; pluck another - loves me not.$(br2)— Petal-plucking divination

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: A small random boon every 8 seconds.$(br2)$(br2)A petal is plucked every 8 seconds, with four outcomes: a heart back, a little food, 3 s of Speed, or nothing at all.$(br2)$(br2)Regeneration 1:30, Divination 3:00
